protocol.layout: One exclusive cpu-interactive node, ACIC 16 processes x 7 workers, +old-scheduler; Wasp uses entire node with selected thread count.
protocol.frozen_application: Baseline from mesh28 attribution; private chunks match 8a6b02c, slice profile 98b80ea. Exact binary manifests retained; no rebuild or solver change.
protocol.timing: Each arm: one held-out warmup and three measured launches per source; four held-out sources. Randomized arm/source order within repetition; duplicate original control.
protocol.wasp_selection: Joint grid on two training sources; one engine warmup; repeat top two settings once on both sources; freeze by geometric mean before held-out runs. No claim of global optimum.

prediction.road-usa-z: Chunks may reduce queue cost but road may remain round-bound; no guaranteed speedup. Preserve road bucket width 131072. Reject transfer if slower beyond duplicate-control spread.
prediction.uniform25: Auto process sharing is off at average degree 32, so chunks and heap slice are inactive. Expected no systematic speed change beyond control variation; do not claim an inactive mechanism as an improvement.

protocol.correctness: Every solve must match independent reference hashes, reachable count and distance sum. Diagnostic base/selected runs on two held-out sources also require conserved edge and queue ledgers.
protocol.acceptance: Graph transfer check in one allocation. Preserve original defaults; no one-node graph-specific adoption claim from a small gain within control variation. Multi-node behavior remains unmeasured.

notes: Charm++ current tracking branch was already up to date; no branch switch was assumed.
Reconverse local LCI pin was preserved.
Reconverse main now defaults backend_poll_freq to 64; the prior runtime default was 4.
Previous campaign runtime and application binaries remain intact.

validation.scope: Local-only runtime checks; distributed shared-memory communication has not been rerun on compute nodes in this refresh.

round_progress_note: Initial observation and final termination observation excluded. Unchanged threshold does not imply an empty round; update activity is created or processed count change.

manifest.method: Pin training-selected Wasp threads; compare delta 16 vs 4 twice on each training source. If 4 wins, compare 4 vs 1 twice; stop there. If selection changes, retime original ACIC, selected chunks/s64 and Wasp on four held-out sources with warmup plus three repetitions. All arms interleaved. No solver changes or delta selection on held-out sources.
